knowledge.plain_language_summary: A brushed-metal wall plaque: a 3/8in 5052 aluminum (or yellow-brass) background panel, 100-grit satin brushed, with 1/4in brushed metal letterforms VHB-mounted and copy etched into the background infilled satin black, on stainless studs/spacers.
knowledge.rationale: A brushed-metal panel with applied letters and etched copy gives a premium restaurant plaque; aluminum vs brass is the only real variant across locations.

structure.construction: 3/8in 5052 aluminum or 3/8in yellow-brass background panel, 100-grit satin brushed, 1/4in brushed letterforms VHB, etched copy infilled satin black, 1/2in stainless studs + 1/2in spacers

craft_observations: Brushed-metal panel + applied letters + etched/filled copy; aluminum vs brass is the only variant.
